tickets.title: Complete insurance policy review workflow
tickets.text: Review Nora Thimblefern’s life insurance policies, including the $750,000 term policy from Silver Marmot Life and the $430,000 employer group coverage, to verify ownership and beneficiary records.

subTasks.title: Collect current policy documents
subTasks.text: Request and organize current declaration pages, policy statements, in-force illustrations where applicable, beneficiary records, premium notices, and carrier correspondence.

subTasks.title: Analyze coverage and ownership
subTasks.text: Compare policy type, coverage amount, insured party, owner, beneficiary, riders, premiums, cash value, surrender provisions, and loan status against the client's planning goals.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor recommendation summary
subTasks.text: Document gaps, overlaps, tax considerations, estate planning coordination needs, and suggested next steps for advisor review.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review life insurance ownership and beneficiary records by 2025-12-16.

tickets.title: Collect mortgage document package

tickets.title: Provide digital asset inventory format
tickets.text: Provide a digital asset and household contact inventory template for Nora Thimblefern, enabling Calvin to locate passwords, subscriptions, and vendor contacts if she becomes incapacitated.
